item.title: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park: A Place of Remembrance — Guide
item.description: The Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park occupies the open ground near the point where the atomic bomb detonated on 6 August 1945, once a busy commercial district reduced to ash in an instant. Rather than rebuild, the city made it a place of memory and a plea for peace. At its edge stands the A-Bomb Dome, a UNESCO World Heritage Site preserved as a ruin exactly as the blast left it, its skeletal frame one of the most powerful anti-war images in the world.
